ETH.note: Teacher training only; no civil-service programme.

facts.fact: Education Africa Magazine reports the Ethiopian government's broader target to train 5,000,000 young people in digital skills, with work said to be underway.

ETH.note: No share of people using the internet stated.

facts.fact: Education Africa Magazine reports that from Grade 7 all students in public and private schools under the national curriculum study Information Technology, including basic coding, as a core subject.
